nodes.title: Team workflow
nodes.subtitle: Task and scope
nodes.detail: An engineer supplies an approved task. Existing delivery controls retain ownership.

nodes.title: Delivery systems
nodes.subtitle: Versioned sources
nodes.detail: Repositories and CI supply approved source material with identity and version information.

nodes.title: AI applications
nodes.subtitle: Configuration versions
nodes.detail: An AI application configuration is evaluated as a separate branch from generated-test execution.

nodes.title: Context service
nodes.subtitle: Permitted evidence
nodes.detail: Retrieve permitted, versioned context. Source text cannot grant permissions.

nodes.title: QE runtime
nodes.subtitle: Bounded generation
nodes.detail: The model proposes a candidate and requested action within a bounded task. It cannot approve its own work.

nodes.title: Action gateway
nodes.subtitle: Independent authority
nodes.detail: Check identity, resource scope, expiry and approval before a tool runs. Denied requests have no tool side effect.

nodes.title: Sandbox checks
nodes.subtitle: Independent proof
nodes.detail: The original implementation passes and a relevant seeded fault fails. A passing test alone does not establish usefulness.

nodes.title: Evidence store
nodes.subtitle: Run / artifact / decision
nodes.detail: Join task, run, artifact, evaluation and human decision. Traces are retained during execution as well as at the release decision.

nodes.title: Regression corpus
nodes.subtitle: Reviewed failure cases
nodes.detail: Curate reviewed failures and approved expectations into versioned cases for future evaluations.

nodes.title: Release authority
nodes.subtitle: Human review and gates
nodes.detail: Independent reviewers and existing delivery gates decide approve or hold; the generator never self-approves.

nodes.title: Evaluation service
nodes.subtitle: Held-out / adversarial
nodes.detail: Run held-out and adversarial cases, deterministic checks and calibrated human or model judges.

scenarios.title: Generate & verify
scenarios.subtitle: From an approved task to independent proof

steps.title: Start with permitted context
steps.body: The engineer supplies a task; delivery systems provide approved, versioned source material.

steps.title: Generate a candidate
steps.body: The QE runtime receives scoped context and drafts a test. Generation creates a proposal, not release authority.

steps.title: Enforce the action boundary
steps.body: The gateway independently checks who may run which tool, on which resource, before execution.

steps.title: Prove useful behavior
steps.body: Run in the sandbox: the original must pass, and a relevant seeded fault must fail.

steps.title: Keep approval independent
steps.body: Evidence reaches the existing reviewer and release gate. The generating agent cannot approve itself.

steps.title: Retain the evidence
steps.body: Join the run, artifact and decision. Runtime traces also accumulate during execution.

steps.title: Learn for the next release
steps.body: Reviewed failures become regression cases. They challenge future evaluations; they do not retroactively approve this run.

steps.title: Version the AI application
steps.body: Treat model, prompt, retrieval, tools and permissions as one evaluated configuration.

steps.title: Evaluate application behavior
steps.body: The application enters held-out, adversarial and calibrated evaluation. This branch is separate from generated-test execution.

steps.title: Challenge with reviewed failures
steps.body: Versioned regression cases provide evidence against the candidate configuration.

steps.title: Decide at the release boundary
steps.body: Relevant evaluation results reach an independent release owner. Mandatory failures mean hold.

steps.title: Preserve the decision trail
steps.body: Keep the configuration, evaluation version and reviewer decision together.

scenarios.title: Deny unsafe action
scenarios.subtitle: A failed authorization leaves no tool side effect

steps.title: An unsafe action is requested
steps.body: A sandbox-only task proposes a production write. Retrieved text cannot expand the task’s permissions.

steps.title: Deny before execution
steps.body: The gateway rejects the action. No packet reaches the sandbox or a production tool.
steps.artifact: DENY · scope mismatch · no tool call

steps.title: Record the denied request
steps.body: Retain identity, requested resource, policy version and denial reason.

steps.title: Hold and escalate
steps.body: The workflow remains held. Any broader action needs a separate authorized request; the agent cannot grant its own access.

scenarios.title: Hold failed proof
scenarios.subtitle: Generation succeeds; independent quality checks fail

steps.title: Execute within approved scope
steps.body: Authorization allows the candidate test into the sandbox. Permission is not proof of quality.

steps.title: The candidate misses the fault
steps.body: A seeded faulty implementation still passes. The test does not establish the required fault detection.

steps.title: Hold the release
steps.body: The failed result reaches the independent release owner. No approval or promotion is implied.

steps.title: Retain and improve the case
steps.body: Record the failure and curate a reviewed case. A revised candidate must pass a new evaluation before approval.
